note: Weekly strength of matchup, 2026. defenses[D][pos] is what defense D has allowed per game to that position this season: ppr = PPR fantasy points, rec = receptions, so half = ppr - 0.5*rec, std = ppr - rec and TE-premium = ppr + bonus*rec (TEs only). rank.<scoring> is 1 = most points allowed = softest matchup for the offense, among defenses that have played. prior is the same ledger for 2025. factor is the StatHead model multiplier the weekly projections apply for that opponent (prior season blended with this one, shrunk toward 1, clamped) and factorRank ranks it the same way; it is the regressed view, the raw ledger is the loud one. schedule[T] lists every game for team T with the opponent, venue, whether it is final and the opponent's factor per position; byes are the missing weeks. Season to date means every final game, including the finished games of a week in progress. Computed by StatHead from nflverse weekly stats.
